xDraft by xDev

FeaturesPrivacyPricingPlatformsHelp and legal

Features

Six ways to draw an idea, one place to keep it.

Pick the diagram that fits the question. Every change can be undone, and AI only ever suggests.

01

Mind maps

Topics lay themselves out on an infinite canvas, or switch to the outline to write and reorder quickly. Everything from MindMap AI is still here.

02

Flowcharts

Start and end, process, input and output, and decision steps with Yes and No branches, laid out for you as you add them.

03

Architecture and C4

Model people, systems, services, data stores and queues with their relationships and nested boundaries, then read the same model as C4 context, container and component views.

04

Deployment and sequence

Place instances of your services in environments and deployment nodes, and draw sequence diagrams with sync, async and reply messages between the same participants.

05

On-device AI

Apple Intelligence runs on your device to generate a map, turn a mind map into a flowchart or an architecture diagram, and suggest the messages of a sequence. Every suggestion is labelled, and you can edit it before you accept it.

06

Undo, sync and search

Undo or redo any step. Your documents sync through your own private iCloud account, and you can search them, keep them in Favorites and restore them from Recently Deleted.

07

Export

Export every diagram as PNG or PDF. Mind maps also export to Markdown and plain text, or to an xDraft Backup file.

08

Connect AI apps on your Mac

Let AI apps such as Claude Code or ChatGPT read your maps through MCP. It is off by default; when you turn it on, each app needs its own token.

Privacy

Data Not Collected

xDraft has no account, no analytics, no ads and no tracking. xDev runs no servers for it, and your maps are never sent to xDev.

Read the privacy policy→
  • AI runs on your device with Apple Intelligence.
  • Your maps are stored on your device.
  • AI apps you connect on a Mac can read your maps only after you turn it on.

Pricing

Free, with a one-time Pro upgrade.

Mind maps and flowcharts are never locked, and there are no ads. No subscription.

xDraft

Free

Everything you need to map ideas and draw flows.

  • Mind maps and flowcharts: canvas, outline, search and templates
  • PNG and one-page PDF export of every diagram type

  • Markdown and plain text import and export for mind maps

xDraft Pro

USD 19.99one-time purchase

For software teams and polished output.

  • Architecture documents with C4, Deployment and Sequence views

Platforms

Made for the Mac first.

Mac

Coming soon to the Mac App Store

Built for the Mac first, with every command in the menu bar, keyboard shortcuts and multiple windows. Requires macOS 26 or later. AI features need a Mac with Apple silicon and Apple Intelligence.

iPhone and iPad

Coming soon to the App Store

A touch-friendly canvas and outline, the Share Extension for text and links, and Shortcuts actions. Requires iOS or iPadOS 26 or later. One Pro purchase covers Mac, iPhone and iPad.

xDraft is available in English, Vietnamese and Japanese.
